deletedAttachmentCleanup.zh: 会话已删除，但部分附件副本未能清理：{detail}
deletedAttachmentCleanup.en: The conversation was deleted, but some attachment copies could not be removed: {detail}

interrupted.zh: 上次创作未确认结束。已保留记录；发送新消息后才会继续，并应先核对已有任务。
interrupted.en: The previous turn did not finish. Your history is retained. Check existing tasks before sending a new message to continue.

stopped.zh: CLI 助手已停止，已有修改保留。已提交的 Copperbench 构建等任务可能仍在运行，可在任务面板查看或停止；再次发送消息才会继续创作。
stopped.en: The CLI assistant stopped. Existing changes are retained. Submitted Copperbench tasks may still be running; inspect or stop them in the task panel. Send another message to continue creating.

retention.zh: 仅显示最近 1,000 条记录；CLI 保留其原生会话历史。
retention.en: Only the latest 1,000 messages are shown. The CLI keeps its native session history.

allowSession.zh: 允许本次 CLI 会话

accessApproval.zh: 允许本轮扩大访问范围？
accessApproval.en: Allow broader access for this turn?

claudeApproval.zh: 允许 Claude Code 使用 {tool}？

busy.zh: 请先停止或等待当前创作完成
busy.en: Stop the current turn or wait for it to finish first.

messageLimit.zh: 消息不能超过 65,536 字符

missingCli.zh: 未找到 {provider}，请先安装并点击检查连接
missingCli.en: {provider} was not found. Install it and detect it again.

providerBinding.zh: 每个会话固定使用一个 CLI，请新建会话后切换工具
providerBinding.en: Each conversation uses one CLI. Start a new conversation to switch assistants.

tooManyApprovals.zh: CLI 同时请求了过多输入，本轮已停止
tooManyApprovals.en: The CLI requested too many simultaneous inputs. This turn was stopped.

turnFailed.en: The CLI did not complete this turn.

expiredApproval.en: This approval request is no longer active.

invalidChoices.en: Question choices must be an array.

customText.zh: 自定义回答必须为文本
customText.en: A custom answer must be text.

noCustom.zh: 此问题不支持自定义回答
noCustom.en: This question does not accept a custom answer.

answerRequired.zh: 请选择选项或填写回答
answerRequired.en: Select an option or enter an answer.

singleAnswer.zh: 此问题只能提交一个回答

deepseekSetup.zh: 请运行 dsh web，在 Settings → Models 中配置模型，然后返回发送消息。
deepseekSetup.en: Run dsh web, configure a model in Settings → Models, then return to send a message.

loginOpened.zh: 已打开 {provider} 的官方登录终端。完成登录后返回检查连接；打开窗口不代表已登录。
loginOpened.en: Opened the official {provider} sign-in terminal. Complete sign-in, then return to check the connection. Opening the window does not confirm sign-in.

sessionLimit.zh: 创作会话已达 100 条，请先整理工作区创作记录
sessionLimit.en: The 100-conversation limit was reached. Manage conversation history before creating another.

byteLimit.zh: 创作记录已达 16 MiB，请整理历史后继续
byteLimit.en: Conversation history reached 16 MiB. Manage history to continue.

readLimit.zh: 创作记录超过读取上限，请保留并整理 {path}
readLimit.en: History exceeds the read limit. Back up and recover it: {path}

unreadable.zh: 无法读取创作记录，原文件已保留：{path}
unreadable.en: Could not read conversation history. The original file is retained: {path}

backupRequired.zh: 请先备份并恢复无法读取的历史记录
backupRequired.en: Back up and recover the unreadable history first.

historyReadable.zh: 历史记录可以读取，请使用会话整理
historyReadable.en: History is readable. Use conversation management.

backupFailed.zh: 历史备份验证失败，原文件未变更
backupFailed.en: The history backup could not be verified. The original file is unchanged.

activeDelete.zh: 请先停止当前会话并等待收尾后再删除
activeDelete.en: Stop the active conversation and wait for it to settle before deleting it.

processPending.zh: CLI 已返回结果，但未正常结束；后台进程已停止，请检查工具任务状态
processPending.en: The CLI returned a result but did not exit normally. Its process was stopped; check tool task status.

childrenRunning.zh: CLI 子进程未能完全停止，请在系统进程管理器中检查 {provider}
childrenRunning.en: Some CLI child processes did not stop. Check {provider} in the system process manager.

noResult.en: The CLI returned no valid result.

invalidProtocol.zh: CLI 返回无法识别的协议消息，请检查 CLI 版本或启动器
invalidProtocol.en: The CLI returned an unsupported protocol message. Check its version or launcher.

outputClosed.en: The CLI output connection is closed.

earlyClose.zh: CLI 连接在本轮完成前关闭{detail}
earlyClose.en: The CLI connection closed before this turn completed.{detail}

closeTimeout.zh: CLI 会话关闭确认超时
closeTimeout.en: CLI session closure confirmation timed out.

initTimeout.zh: CLI 初始化或会话恢复超时，请检查登录与网络
initTimeout.en: CLI initialization or session recovery timed out. Check sign-in and network access.

lineLimit.zh: CLI 消息超过 2 Mi 字符限制
lineLimit.en: A CLI message exceeded the 2 Mi character limit.

acpVersion.zh: {provider} 的 ACP 版本不兼容，请更新 CLI 后重试。
acpVersion.en: The ACP version of {provider} is incompatible. Update the CLI and try again.

deepseekResume.zh: 此版本的 DeepSeek Harness 不支持恢复会话，请更新 dsh 或新建对话。
deepseekResume.en: This DeepSeek Harness version does not support session recovery. Update dsh or start a new conversation.

deniedOperation.zh: {provider} 有操作未获授权，请检查拒绝信息后明确继续。
deniedOperation.en: An operation was not authorized for {provider}. Review the denial before explicitly continuing.

unsupportedClient.zh: {provider} 请求了未启用的客户端能力：{method}；未执行该操作。
unsupportedClient.en: {provider} requested an unavailable client capability: {method}. The operation was not performed.

incompleteApproval.zh: {provider} 未提供当前操作的完整信息，审批请求已取消。
incompleteApproval.en: {provider} did not provide complete operation details. The approval request was cancelled.

noApprovalChoices.zh: {provider} 未提供可选择的批准选项，该请求已取消。
noApprovalChoices.en: {provider} provided no approval choices. The request was cancelled.

codexUnknown.zh: 未知的 Codex 结束状态：{status}

unsupportedRequest.zh: CLI 请求暂不支持：{method}。该动作未获批准，可停止并调整任务。
unsupportedRequest.en: Unsupported CLI request: {method}. The action was not approved. Stop and adjust the task if needed.

claudeRetry.zh: Claude Code 正在重试连接：{detail}
claudeRetry.en: Claude Code is retrying the connection: {detail}

claudePermission.zh: 有操作未获 Claude Code 授权；请查看拒绝信息，调整 CLI 权限后明确继续。
claudePermission.en: Claude Code did not authorize an operation. Review the denial, adjust CLI permissions, then explicitly continue.

claudeFailed.en: Claude Code did not complete successfully: {detail}

claudeControl.zh: Claude 请求的控制操作暂不支持，未执行该操作：{detail}
claudeControl.en: The requested Claude control operation is unsupported and was not performed: {detail}

antigravityPermission.zh: Antigravity 已拒绝需要批准的操作。其无界面模式不支持交互授权；请在官方 CLI 中调整所需权限，再返回明确继续。
antigravityPermission.en: Antigravity denied an operation requiring approval. Headless mode does not support interactive approval. Adjust permissions in the official CLI, then return and explicitly continue.

antigravityDenied.zh:
Antigravity 权限拒绝：{detail}
请在官方 CLI 中处理所需权限后重新发送；这里不会伪造批准。
antigravityDenied.en:
Antigravity permission denial: {detail}
Handle permissions in the official CLI, then explicitly send again.

antigravityFailed.zh: Antigravity 有操作因权限被拒绝；请在官方 CLI 中处理权限后明确继续。
antigravityFailed.en: Antigravity denied an operation. Handle permissions in the official CLI before explicitly continuing.

browserUnavailable.zh: 无法打开浏览器，请访问 {url}
browserUnavailable.en: Could not open a browser. Visit {url}

loginTimeout.en: Opening the sign-in window timed out.

loginFailed.zh: 无法打开登录窗口，请在终端运行官方 CLI 登录命令
loginFailed.en: Could not open sign-in. Run the official CLI sign-in command in a terminal.

cmdCharacters.zh: CLI 启动路径或参数含不支持的 cmd 字符；请选择 .exe 或 .ps1 启动器
cmdCharacters.en: The CLI path or arguments contain unsupported cmd characters. Use an .exe or .ps1 launcher.

remoteId.zh: CLI 返回了无效的会话标识
remoteId.en: The CLI returned an invalid session identifier.

modelId.zh: 模型 ID 格式无效

modelLimit.zh: 模型列表超过读取上限
modelLimit.en: The model list exceeds the read limit.

modelEmpty.zh: 当前服务未返回可用模型，请刷新或输入模型 ID
modelEmpty.en: The service returned no available models. Refresh or enter a model ID.

modelTimeout.en: Loading the model list timed out.

modelCommand.zh: 模型列表命令失败，请检查 CLI 登录与服务配置
modelCommand.en: The model list command failed. Check CLI sign-in and service settings.

modelCredentials.zh: 模型凭据格式无效，请检查主机 CLI 配置
modelCredentials.en: The model credential is invalid. Check the host CLI settings.

modelAddress.en: The model service address is invalid.

modelProjectAddress.zh: 项目覆盖了模型服务地址，请先在主机 CLI 配置中确认该源
modelProjectAddress.en: The project overrides the model service address. Confirm the source in the host CLI settings first.

modelProjectConfig.zh: 项目覆盖了模型服务配置，请先在主机 CLI 配置中确认该源
modelProjectConfig.en: The project overrides the model service settings. Confirm the source in the host CLI settings first.

modelConfigLimit.zh: CLI 配置文件过大，无法读取模型服务设置
modelConfigLimit.en: The CLI configuration file is too large to read model service settings.

modelConfigRead.zh: 无法读取 CLI 的模型服务设置
modelConfigRead.en: Could not read the CLI model service settings.

modelConnection.zh: 无法连接模型列表服务，请检查当前源与网络
modelConnection.en: Could not connect to the model list service. Check the source and network.

modelHttp.zh: 模型列表请求失败（HTTP {code}），请检查当前源与权限
modelHttp.en: The model list request failed (HTTP {code}). Check the source and permissions.

modelResponse.zh: 模型服务返回了无法读取的列表
modelResponse.en: The model service returned an unreadable list.

modelPagination.en: The model list returned invalid pagination.

modelUnconfirmed.zh: CLI 未确认所选模型，本轮未发送
modelUnconfirmed.en: The CLI did not confirm the selected model. The message was not sent.

modelUnsupported.zh: 此 CLI 版本未提供模型选择，请更新后重试
modelUnsupported.en: This CLI version does not support model selection. Update it and try again.

modelUnsupportedProtocol.zh: 此 CLI 不支持指定模型
modelUnsupportedProtocol.en: This CLI does not support selecting a model.

modelCatalogUnsupported.zh: 当前 CLI 未提供模型列表，请输入模型 ID
modelCatalogUnsupported.en: This CLI does not provide a model list. Enter a model ID.

modelFixed.zh: 每个会话固定使用一个模型，请新建对话后切换模型
modelFixed.en: Each conversation uses one model. Start a new conversation to change models.

attachmentsOptions4.zh: 附件目录不在当前工作区内
attachmentsOptions4.en: The attachment directory is outside this workspace.

attachmentsOptions7.zh: 附件大小或分块位置无效
attachmentsOptions7.en: Invalid attachment size or chunk offset.

attachmentsOptions9.zh: 附件须非空且不超过 10 MiB
attachmentsOptions9.en: Each attachment must be non-empty and no larger than 10 MiB.

attachmentsOptions10.zh: 同时最多添加 8 个附件
attachmentsOptions10.en: Add up to 8 attachments at a time.

attachmentsOptions11.zh: 附件存储已达 256 MiB，请删除不再需要的对话附件
attachmentsOptions11.en: Attachment storage has reached 256 MiB. Delete conversations with attachments you no longer need.

attachmentsOptions12.zh: 附件上传已失效，请重新添加
attachmentsOptions12.en: This upload is no longer available. Add the file again.

attachmentsOptions13.en: The attachment chunk is too large.

attachmentsOptions15.zh: 附件分块顺序或大小无效，请重新添加
attachmentsOptions15.en: Invalid attachment chunk order or size. Add the file again.

attachmentsOptions16.en: The attachment has not finished uploading.

attachmentsOptions17.zh: 附件不存在或路径无效，请重新添加
attachmentsOptions17.en: The attachment is missing or its path is invalid. Add it again.

attachmentsOptions18.zh: 图片请使用 PNG、JPEG 或 GIF 格式
attachmentsOptions18.en: Use a PNG, JPEG or GIF image.

attachmentsOptions19.zh: 图片不能超过 5 MiB 或 2,400 万像素
attachmentsOptions19.en: Images must be no larger than 5 MiB or 24 megapixels.

attachmentsOptions20.zh: 无法读取图片，请重新选择
attachmentsOptions20.en: The image could not be read. Select it again.

attachmentsOptions21.zh: 无法读取图片，请转换为 PNG、JPEG 或 GIF 后添加
attachmentsOptions21.en: The image could not be read. Convert it to PNG, JPEG or GIF and add it again.

attachmentsOptions23.zh: 附件内容已变化，请重新添加
attachmentsOptions23.en: The attachment contents changed. Add it again.

attachmentsOptions24.zh: 附件图片格式已变化，请重新添加
attachmentsOptions24.en: The image format changed. Add it again.

attachmentsOptions26.zh: 每条消息最多 8 个附件
attachmentsOptions26.en: Attach up to 8 files per message.

attachmentsOptions27.zh: 每条消息的附件总大小不能超过 20 MiB
attachmentsOptions27.en: Attachments must total 20 MiB or less per message.

attachmentsOptions28.zh: 每次最多添加 8 个附件
attachmentsOptions28.en: Add up to 8 attachments at a time.

attachmentsOptions29.zh: 请选择文件，不能添加文件夹

attachmentsOptions30.en: This attachment has no image preview.

attachmentsOptions31.zh: 请填写消息或添加附件
attachmentsOptions31.en: Write a message or add an attachment.

attachmentsOptions32.zh: Antigravity 当前流式接口不支持图片，请移除图片或切换助手
attachmentsOptions32.en: The current Antigravity streaming interface does not accept images. Remove the image or switch assistants.

attachmentsOptions33.zh: 此 CLI 或当前模型未声明图片支持，请移除图片或切换助手与模型
attachmentsOptions33.en: This CLI or model does not advertise image support. Remove the image or choose another assistant and model.

attachmentsOptions34.zh: 此 CLI 或所选模型未提供思考强度设置，请换用支持的模型
attachmentsOptions34.en: This CLI or model does not provide reasoning effort settings. Choose a model that supports them.

attachmentsOptions35.zh: CLI 未确认所选思考强度，请选择该模型支持的档位
attachmentsOptions35.en: The CLI did not confirm the requested effort. Choose a level supported by the model.

attachmentsOptions36.zh: 多个提供方包含此模型，请从列表选择完整模型 ID
attachmentsOptions36.en: Multiple providers have this model. Select the full model ID from the list.

cliLineLimit.zh: CLI 消息超过读取上限
cliLineLimit.en: The CLI message exceeds the read limit.
